signals.title: feat: agent skills for deploying BentoML services to Kubernetes and EC2
signals.text: ## What this PR does With BentoCloud winding down, this adds a set of **Claude Code agent skills** (under `.claude/skills/`) that give users a fully open-source path from a local BentoML project to a running service on infrastructure they own: the `bentoml` CLI, Docker, `kubectl` with plain manifests, `ssh`, and the AWS CLI. No Helm, no operators/CRDs, no Yatai, no closed-source dependencies. | Skill | Purpose | |---|---| | `bentoml-containerize` | project → `bentoml build` → `bentoml containerize` → local smoke test (content-verified) → push to Docker Hub / GHCR / ECR / private registry / kind / minikube / ttl.sh | | `bentoml-k8s-deploy` | pushed image → parameterized Deployment/Service(/Ingress) manifests rendered into the project's `k8s/` → `kubectl apply` → rollout verified with a real inference request | | `bentoml-k8s-troubleshoot` | decision-tree runbook for 10 common K8s failure modes (image pull, crash loops, OOM, Pending/GPU, probes, stuck rollouts, networking, 4xx/5xx, rejected manifests, port-forward false positives) | | `bentoml-ec2-deploy` | pushed image → Docker on one or more plain EC2 instances (existing via SSH, or provisioned via AWS CLI with SSM AMI lookup) → tunnel-verified inference → teardown | | `bentoml-deploy-scriptgen` | generates a standalone, committable `deploy/` bundle (plain Python ≥ 3.9, stdlib only) that repeats build → containerize → push → deploy → verify **with no agent** — for production and CI/CD | Scope is intentionally **basic deployment only** — BentoCloud-era features (autoscaling on inference metrics, canary, scale-to-zero) are out of scope; standard building blocks (HPA, ALB) get one-line pointers. ### Two ways to deploy - **Interactive** (`bentoml-containerize` → a deploy skill) for the first deploy of a service: the agent detects the project, asks the right questions, confirms every mutation, provisions where allowed, and troubleshoots on the spot. - **Script bundle** (`bentoml-deploy-scriptgen`) for every deploy after that: aggregated preflight matrix with actionable messages (build deps, docker, registry auth incl. probed ECR token expiry, image existence, kubectl context/RBAC/namespace, SSH key/host/docker/arch), `--check-only --local-only` for credential-free PR gates, deterministic git-SHA tags, idempotent per target, semantic exit codes 0–7, and a one-line JSON summary on stdout. Secrets come only from env vars; over SSH they travel base64-on-stdin with names-only argv. The bundle README ships GitHub Actions (OIDC) and GitLab CI examples. `.claude/skills/README.md` is a full user guide: skills overview, target decision flow, prerequisites matrix, installation (plugin marketplace / `npx skills` / manual), per-skill configuration reference, a worked end-to-end example, and cost warnings. The repo also becomes a Claude Code plugin marketplace, so users can install everything with `/plugin marketplace add bentoml/BentoML` + `/plugin install bentoml-deploy@bentoml`. ## How it was validated - Every claimed BentoML CLI/server behavior verified against this repo's source; every AWS CLI command verified against aws-cli 2.13.28 + AWS docs. - **Kubernetes**: interactive path e2e on a real k3s cluster and on minikube; the script bundle exercised end to end with **no agent** — full `build → containerize → push to ECR → apply → rollout → readyz + content-checked inference` on a fresh k3s cluster, plus idempotent re-runs. - **EC2**: interactive path provisioned a real t3.micro (SSM AMI lookup, SG, key pair, ECR pull, tunnel-verified inference, verified clean teardown); the script bundle then deployed to a real instance with the full preflight matrix green (live ECR probes, SSH/arch/host-port ownership checks) and verified inference through a banner-gated SSH tunnel. - Two demo services were deployed across all targets for manual verification: the official single-service quickstart and a purpose-written dual-service example (`bentoml.depends()` gateway → inner service). - Each skill and the script bundle passed independent adversarial review rounds with fix-and-re-review loops; the bundle is `ruff` (repo-pinned) and `py_compile` clean on Python 3.9 and 3.10. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
signals.author: xianml

signals.title: docs: fix broken YOLO repository link in documentation and README
signals.text: ## Description Fixes #5686. The link to \https://github.com/bentoml/BentoYolo\ under Computer Vision in \README.md\ and \docs/source/examples/overview.rst\ returned 404 Not Found. This PR updates the Computer Vision examples in the \README.md\ and \docs/source/examples/overview.rst\ to link to the active [BentoResnet](https://github.com/bentoml/BentoResnet) and [BentoOCR](https://github.com/bentoml/BentoOCR) example repositories. ## Changes - \README.md\: update Computer Vision line to link to \BentoResnet\ and \BentoOCR\. - \docs/source/examples/overview.rst\: remove 404 \BentoYolo\ entry and retain \BentoResnet\ and \BentoOCR\.
signals.author: vjymisal0
